description: Whitelist of UI components that are permitted to render command-language strings (BUY_TO_OPEN, ADD_LONG, TRIM_LONG, SELL_TO_CLOSE, etc.). The desktop test suite scans the rendered DOM and asserts that no node outside these components contains command words. See VIZA_INVESTMENT_COMMAND_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md §1.1 Phase 27 'Language gate'.
boundary_note: Command words are sanctioned ONLY inside simulation/live-mode cards that carry the mode badge, the sandbox/live audit chain, and the 'execution routing: none' disclosure. Free-text prose anywhere else must not contain them.
